Age Suitability

The Royal Game of Ur for iOS and Android. Last updated 3 November 2026.

In short: The Royal Game of Ur is a two-player dice and strategy board game. It has no violence, no chat, no accounts, no ads and no tracking.

What is in the game

So you can judge for yourself, here is what the app does and does not contain:

  • No violence. Stones race along a board, and a stone can send an opposing stone back to the start. Nothing is hurt, and there are no fighting scenes.
  • No gambling and no simulated gambling. Dice decide how far a stone moves, but nothing is wagered and nothing of real or virtual value can be won or lost.
  • No bad language, no sexual or mature content, no references to drugs, alcohol or tobacco, and nothing frightening.
  • No user-generated content and no way to message or contact other players. You play a friend on one device, or you play the computer. There is no online multiplayer.
  • No accounts, and no sign-in of any kind.
  • No access to your location, contacts, photos, camera or microphone.

Purchases and links

The app offers one optional, one-time purchase that opens every board and stone colour. Apple takes the payment. Apple’s own parental controls, such as Ask to Buy and Screen Time, decide whether a child can buy it, and Lumoxia has no say in them.

The Rules panel has a few links to other websites (the Lumoxia pages, a history video and the credits for the sound tools). They open in your browser, and those websites are not controlled by Lumoxia.

Privacy for children

The app collects no personal information from anyone, children included. The full policy is on the Privacy Policy page.

Age rules in different countries

The Royal Game of Ur is not a social media app. It has no accounts, no profiles and no way for people to contact each other, so age-based rules for social media accounts, such as the rule for people under 16 in Australia, do not apply to it. This is a description of the app, not legal advice.

Changes to this page

If the app ever adds something that changes the above, such as online play, chat or ads, this page will be updated, with the date above, before the change ships.
